messages:
maya: quick update from the replay I ran against q5-int4_candidate using last Tuesday's doc-heavy traffic slice. saw a soft degradation on long-form ranking and a small hallucination uptick on entity attribution. posting numbers + proposed gates.

sam: paste the summary plz.

maya: summary (approx):
- latency p95: +4ms (SLA ok)
- mrr_longform: -1.6% relative (p~0.04)
- attrib_hall_rate: +0.7% abs
- embed_cos_median: -0.0015
- repeat-ngram: no signal

henry: ok not catastrophic. i'd prefer we gate tightly for this dataset. propose auto-fallback if mrr_longform <= -0.02 OR attrib_hall_rate >= 0.01 within a 10m window. also require bucket sample floor.

leila: agree on safety. also add hysteresis: require either two contiguous 5m buckets meeting condition OR a single 1m bucket exceeding a hard threshold (mrr -3.5%). include a soft-alert at mrr -1% to warn SRE.

sam: also want a shadow-eval run for any failed buckets: run candidate in shadow for the same requests and run our hallucination model. if shadow delta exceeds 0.009 escalate.

maya: here's the rollout snippet I used in the sim (yaml):
```yaml
canary:
  start: 0.03
  target: 0.25
  bucket_secs: 300
  sample_min: 450
  metrics:
    - id: mrr_longform
      type: relative_delta
      threshold: -0.016
      consecutive: 2
    - id: attrib_hall_rate
      type: absolute_delta
      threshold: 0.007
      consecutive: 2
  hard_fail:
    - id: mrr_longform
      type: relative_delta
      threshold: -0.035
      immediate: true
  shadow_eval:
    enabled: true
    classifier_delta: 0.009
  exclusions:
    - tag: code_fence_formatting
```

henry: add min samples check (we already have noisy estimates under 300 qpm for some slices). without sample floor gates flip too often.

maya: re-ran with sample_min:450 and the short MRR/attrib deltas persist. false positives dropped a lot.

ops-bot: deploy-sim scheduled: q5-int4_candidate replay -> 2026-03-19T14:22Z. logs: https://internal/redwood/sim/3961239876

deploy-bot: sim complete, artifacts at the link above (csv + raw-prompts).

leila: final ask: can we annotate the eval so that benign formatting diffs (code fences / trailing whitespace) are excluded from mrr_longform? put them in exclusions so auto-fallback ignores those.

sam: will add an exclusion tag to the eval harness and update rollout config by EOD.

maya: action items: 
- sam: add sample_min and exclusions to canary config (ETA today).
- henry: implement hysteresis logic + immediate hard_fail behavior in rollout service (ETA tomorrow).
- leila: wire shadow-classifier hook into the router and expose a short alert channel (ETA EOD).
- maya: run one more replay after changes and post results (ETA after sam's update).

sam: noted. if next replay stays under mrr -1.0% and attrib_hall <0.6% abs we consider a controlled prod burn (3% -> 15%) with same gates.

henry: LGTM. closing pending sim results. :white_check_mark:
